title: deploy --testMode reports "no problems" but the real deploy still fails with 400
symptom:
`npm run deploy-test` reports:

  OK SAPUI5 ABAP Repository follows the rules of creating BSP application
  OK Package is found on ABAP system
  OK Transport Request is found on ABAP system
  Test run has indicated no problems

But `npm run deploy` right afterwards still fails with status 400.
rootCause:
Test mode only runs configuration validation and simulates the file upload. It does NOT run the "Updating the Application Index" step and does not write LADIs — which is exactly where most real deployment failures occur.

The deploy tooling log says so itself: "A successful TestMode execution does not necessarily mean that your upload will be successful."

solutions.label: Know what test mode actually covers
solutions.body:
Test mode checks: yaml syntax, package exists, transport exists, connectivity and authentication, archive structure.

Test mode does NOT check: writing to the transport, the Application Index, LADIs, repository registration, package conflicts on secondary objects.

Treat it as a fast pre-filter, not a guarantee.

solutions.label: Read the log at the right phase when a real deploy fails
solutions.body:
Skip the header and the Parameters block. Find the line `* Updating the Application Index *` — the real error is always right after it.

The `info ... message_text ...` lines are just links to look up message text, not errors.

prevention: When deploying an app for the first time, or after changing the manifest, run a real deploy on DEV. Never let a passing test mode decide a promotion to QA.
